name: obw
description: Obsidian Workspace — project-scoped vault project management. /obw:pm is the one command: it owns setup, folder layout and templates, files tasks and docs under pm/<project>/ by their content, and splits a spec into blocking tickets; /issue is a Claude Mod pane that lists a view of the project's dashboard, draws Mermaid as text diagrams, and can open a card in the browser through viz. Vault I/O uses the Obsidian CLI via the official obsidian-cli skill.
